blind.description: A low, circular stylized garden parterre or raised flowerbed. It features an outer border ring of clipped dark green hedge, containing concentric layers of stylized floral blooms: an outer ring of pale yellow/cream blossoms, an inner ring of crimson-red flowers, and a raised central dome of bright golden-yellow/orange florets. The geometry consists of solid, stylized sculpted mounds and pinched floral forms with no detached, floating, or broken elements. The model rests flat on its circular underside.
blind.from_above: A circular, concentric target or mandala-like pattern with a dark green rim, pale yellow outer ring, dark red middle ring, and a bright yellow-orange textured center, with the red ring bulging slightly into the cream ring on one side.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/5 the height of the figure (around 1 to 1.2 ft tall); diameter is roughly 3.5 to 4 ft across, about two-thirds the height of the figure.
